site.name: Lower Indus, Sindh
site.tagline: Floods, wetlands and rice on the lower Indus

params.water_calibration: Keenjhar Lake (water) vs Rocky desert near Jhimpir (check area) (dry land)
params.water_rule: HH and HV below thresholds calibrated on a permanent reference lake, or both channels at least 3 dB darker than the pixel's own median
params.flood_rule: HH rise >= 3 dB above pixel median, HH rise exceeds HV rise by >= 2 dB, HH >= -6 dB, not built-up

classes.4: no valid radar data (masked swath gap)

left-bank-farms.name: Left bank farmland, Tando Muhammad Khan to Matli

keenjhar.name: Keenjhar Lake
keenjhar.note: Freshwater reservoir that supplies Karachi; Ramsar site.

badin-lagoons.name: Badin coastal lagoons
badin-lagoons.note: Nurri and Jubho lagoons, Ramsar wetlands near the coast.

indus-floodplain.name: Indus floodplain, Kotri to Thatta
indus-floodplain.note: River channel and kaccha (active floodplain) farmland.

left-bank-farms.name: Left bank farmland, Tando Muhammad Khan to Matli
left-bank-farms.note: Irrigated rice, sugarcane and cotton belt.

hyderabad.name: Hyderabad city
hyderabad.note: Stable bright target used as a radiometric sanity check.

jhimpir-desert.name: Rocky desert near Jhimpir (check area)
jhimpir-desert.note: Dry ground that is almost as dark as water in HH. Used to check that the water rule does not misfire.

rain.source: NASA POWER daily PRECTOTCORR (MERRA-2 and GEOS-IT), mm/day
rain.caveat: Model reanalysis at about 50 km resolution. It smooths out local convective downpours, so single storm totals can be much higher on the ground than shown.
